chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
“When a woman reaches fifty years of age, she does not see menstrual blood, unless she is a woman from Quraysh.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman; the legal subject addressed in the ruling
key_terms.حُمْرَةً: redness; a reference here to menstrual blood
key_terms.خَمْسِينَ: fifty; the age threshold mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.قُرَيْشٍ: Quraysh; the tribe mentioned as an exception to the general rule

ai.seo_question: At what age does menstruation cease to be legally recognized according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the age at which menstruation is no longer recognized for women. It states a general limit of fifty years, with an exception for women from Quraysh.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.198 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
'When a woman reaches the age of fifty, She does not see menstruation except if She is a woman from Quraysh.'
